data_availability.note: The public synthetic adaptation benchmark is reproducible for its declared task-accuracy estimand. The restricted deployment adapter input remains unavailable and is not represented as independently validated.

reproducibility.adaptation_benchmark: python models/run_adaptation_experiment.py --model qwen25-0.5b=LOCAL_SNAPSHOT --model qwen25-3b=LOCAL_SNAPSHOT --model qwen25-vl-3b=LOCAL_SNAPSHOT --frontier LOCAL_FRONTIER --tasks measure/results/adaptation_tasks.json --output measure/results/adaptation-multimodel.json --adapter-root measure/results/adaptation_adapters
reproducibility.adaptation_template_holdout: python models/adaptation_template_holdout.py --model qwen25-0.5b=LOCAL_SNAPSHOT --model qwen25-3b=LOCAL_SNAPSHOT --model qwen25-vl-3b=LOCAL_SNAPSHOT --frontier LOCAL_FRONTIER --reuse-adapters --tasks measure/results/adaptation-template-holdout-tasks.json --output measure/results/adaptation-template-holdout.json --adapter-root measure/results/adaptation_adapters
reproducibility.adaptation_semantic_holdout: python models/adaptation_semantic_holdout.py --model qwen25-0.5b=LOCAL_SNAPSHOT --model qwen25-3b=LOCAL_SNAPSHOT --model qwen25-vl-3b=LOCAL_SNAPSHOT --frontier LOCAL_FRONTIER --reuse-adapters --tasks measure/results/adaptation-semantic-holdout-tasks.json --output measure/results/adaptation-semantic-holdout.json --adapter-root measure/results/adaptation_adapters

claim_boundary: Two papers are public alphaXiv preprints (v1, 2026-09-21). No journal venue, DOI, acceptance record, or peer review is asserted for any paper.
